Global (All).title: North Korea Conducts Ballistic Missile Test
Global (All).summary: Pyongyang tested an ICBM, sparking concerns over regional stability and global security.

Global (All).title: US-China Trade Tensions Escalate
Global (All).summary: The ongoing trade war between the two global powers is causing market volatility and uncertainty.

Global (All).title: Ukraine Conflict Intensifies
Global (All).summary: The conflict between Ukrainian forces and Russian-backed separatists is escalating, posing a risk to regional stability.

United States.title: Rising Tensions Over US-China Relations
United States.summary: The US and China have been experiencing increased tensions regarding trade, technology, and global security, with multiple incidents reported in the past week, including a US Navy destroyer sailing through the Taiwan Strait and a meeting between Chinese and US military leaders to discuss maritime security.

United States.title: Mass Shooting in California Leaves Multiple Dead
United States.summary: A mass shooting in Half Moon Bay, California, resulted in the deaths of several people and multiple injuries, with the suspect reportedly taken into custody.

United States.title: US Immigration Policy Under Fire Amid Border Crisis
United States.summary: The US-Mexico border has seen a surge in migrant arrivals, leading to tensions between the US and Mexico governments, with criticism of the US immigration policy and calls for reform.

South Korea.title: North Korean Ballistic Missile Launches, South Korea and US Conduct Joint Exercises
South Korea.summary: On August 10, 2023, North Korea launched three ballistic missiles, which South Korea and the US responded to with joint military exercises.

South Korea.title: South Korea and Japan Resume Intelligence Sharing
South Korea.summary: On August 7, 2023, South Korea and Japan announced the resumption of their intelligence sharing agreement, ending a 14-month feud.

South Korea.title: South Korean Opposition Leader Charged with Corruption
South Korea.summary: On August 5, 2023, South Korean opposition leader Lee Jae-myung was charged with corruption in a case involving alleged embezzlement and tax evasion.

Japan.title: Typhoon Nanmadol brings strong winds to Japan
Japan.summary: Typhoon Nanmadol made landfall in Japan on August 9, 2024, causing strong winds and heavy rainfall. The storm has caused power outages, damaged buildings, and flooded roads.

Japan.title: Japan's Economy Contracts for 2nd Consecutive Quarter
Japan.summary: Japan's economy contracted for the second consecutive quarter in Q2 2024, according to a report by the Ministry of Finance. The contraction is attributed to weak domestic demand and supply chain disruptions.

Japan.title: Protester's deaths raise concerns about Japan’s labor law
Japan.summary: Two protesters died during a labor dispute at a Japanese factory on August 5, 2024. The incident has raised concerns about Japan's labor law and its impact on workers' rights.
